defective_pattern: Compressing multiple regression into 1 table and binary logistic regression into 1 table in a mixed-method hypothesis.
why_defective: Lumps together ANOVA variance decomposition and coefficients in multiple regression, and collapses goodness-of-fit / Omnibus tests with logistic odds ratios in logistic regression, violating the institutional standard.
observed_symptoms: Multiple regression represented as a single table
Logistic regression represented as a single table
ANOVA columns mixed with coefficient columns
corrective_remedy: For any hypothesis containing simple, multiple, and logistic regressions, generate exactly 7 tables: 1 correlation table, and 2 tables for each of the 3 regressions (Model Summary/ANOVA or Omnibus Fit + Coefficients/Equation parameters).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of fewer than 7 tables in a mixed simple/multiple/logistic regression hypothesis block, or detection of combined ANOVA/Coefficients columns in a single table structure.
